name: FinsROV — make and buy assembly
issues: External Configuration.STEP is50 top-level occurrences /142 source solids, not142 independently manufactured items. It omits electronics, cables, seals and nearly all standard assembly fasteners.
The separate metal servo horn CAD is placed twice, whereas BOM requires4 horns. Missing2 horn placements are unresolved; source servo assembly scope must be reconciled before release.

BOM row14 calls for a3D-printed internal cabin bracket. That bracket is absent from external Configuration.STEP and not among the6 fabrication definitions selected so far; In-cabin_Layout.STEP must be separately inspected and a printable source located.
BOM quantities for standard screws are explicitly for reference only; the source asks builders to prepare extra. Grade/material and actual thread engagement remain unspecified here.
BOM has12 O-rings, outer diameter12mm ×1.5mm, but the external CAD has no separately named gasket occurrences. The pressure enclosure kit may also contain vendor seals; verify kit scope.
BOM specifies1 camera but no exact purchased camera model. Full electrical/wiring CAD and functional sensor integration are outside this external assembly.
Mirrored thruster/servo CAD products are purchase-unit variants, not makeable internal designs. Thruster children YD11-24-*.stp /PRT0001.stp /9-16-2.stp are supplier internal geometry.
Pressure cabin and dome+plate CAD correspond to one purchased kit BOM item; thrusters correspond to4 purchased CW/CCW pairs. Procurement quantities must be aggregated by BOM unit.

Original CNC workbook specifies aluminium alloy and anodizing but no alloy grade/temper or complete toleranced manufacturing drawings. Rear hatch is an8mm flat plate with a48-hole pattern, not merely a turned cylinder.

finsrov-nauo12: The upstream CAD mirrors an asymmetric QFS2025. This occurrence uses the same real servo as the other three, with a proper rigid placement matching its output axis and four mounting holes. Source mirror asymmetry is corrected; no mirrored supplier model is invented.
